hypothesis: An attributed synthesized root-checkout recipe, with exact Git metadata and explicit CPython 3.12 selection, runs the complete pinned iniconfig test suite and proves the intended local package was tested.
authorization: User activated keep going until we get stuck / need to review and make decisions after the proposed bounded Linux execution trial. This is the distinct candidate-execution phase, outside acquisition.
scope: One previously inspected development task; two fresh Linux arm64 containers. No held-out campaign, task-benefit or cross-platform claim.
source: Full public Git history/tags and detached checkout at the fixed commit, acquired without upstream execution. Verify all 16 tracked blobs against the parent frozen source before transfer and after setup/testing.

environmentPreparation.additionalTool: Debian git package; record final image ID and complete tool/package versions before candidate execution.
environmentPreparation.freeze: Record source archive hash, image identity, controller/runner hashes and commands before the first measured run.

recipe.method: synthesized and experimentally observed, not an upstream-extracted CI command

isolation.hostMounts: Only an owned first-party controller file, read-only; no credentials, socket or home mounts.
isolation.network: Dependency setup may use network; disconnect before all provenance imports and test execution.
isolation.secrets: No host environment or credentials forwarded.

acceptance: Exact Linux/CPython 3.12 interpreter and distribution path observed; imported package path and all tracked blob hashes match this revision.
Setup and test exit zero; at least 34 test cases, no failures/errors/skips, and JUnit covers every top-level test definition.
Original pyproject.toml and uv.lock remain byte-identical.
The test network is disconnected and hard limits are inspected. Timeout control must prove the container and its child terminate.
Both assigned fresh runs must satisfy the same conditions. Failed attempts remain in the denominator; any recipe amendment gets a new specification.
negativeOutcome: A failure, wrong package/interpreter/source identity, incomplete test collection, missing execution evidence or failed teardown is no-go. Even two passes establish only this synthesized recipe in this environment, not production consumer eligibility or economic benefit.
